name: CityGS Training Pipeline
aliases: Block-wise Parallel Training with Global Prior
definition: A training strategy for large-scale scenes that uses a coarse global Gaussian prior to prevent geometric inaccuracies and floaters during block-wise training, enabling parallel processing and reliable fusion.
summary: CityGS is a divide-and-conquer training method for large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses a coarse global prior to enable parallel block-wise finetuning and ensure seamless fusion without complex alignment.
